svg.aria-label: Query time over the rounds after the cold run
svg.text: Query time over the rounds after the cold run
3 repetitions per configuration, each in a fresh browser (or Node process): every query once cold, then 30 recorded rounds without warmup. y:
time of a typical query (geometric mean over queries and repetitions) relative to the median of the same run's last 10 rounds; log scale.
watdiv-1, watdiv-10, bsbm-100, bsbm-1k together (Comunica 300 queries, Oxigraph 300 queries). Comunica 55a70ad (rdf-stores 2.9.0), Oxigraph
